metadata.title: PolySwarm - IP Association Enrichment - Incident Triggered
metadata.description: Takes every IP entity on a Microsoft Sentinel incident and asks PolySwarm which analysed artifacts have been observed in association with it, writing the association count and a sample of hashes back to the incident as a comment.
prerequisites: A PolySwarm API key with access to the target community, stored as a secret in an Azure Key Vault. Get a key at https://polyswarm.network/account/api-keys
postDeployment: 1. Grant this playbook's system-assigned managed identity the 'Key Vault Secrets User' role on the Key Vault named in KeyVaultName.
2. Assign the 'Microsoft Sentinel Responder' role on the resource group (or workspace) to this playbook's system-assigned managed identity.
3. Authorize the Microsoft Sentinel and Key Vault API connections if they show as unauthorized.
4. Attach the playbook to an automation rule so it runs when an incident is created.
5. Read the note on interpretation in the comment output before acting on results: association is a pivot lead, not a verdict.

metadata.description: Name of the Logic App playbook resource.
Version string sent in the User-Agent header on every call to the PolySwarm API. Bump this when the solution version changes.
Name of the Azure Key Vault holding the PolySwarm API key.
Name of the secret in KeyVaultName that holds the PolySwarm API key.
PolySwarm REST API v3 base URL.
How many associated SHA256 hashes to list in the incident comment. The API returns up to 'limit' per page; this only controls how many are shown.

Get_PolySwarm_API_Key.description: Reads the PolySwarm API key from Azure Key Vault through this playbook's system-assigned managed identity. The identity needs the 'Key Vault Secrets User' role on the vault named in KeyVaultName.

Search_PolySwarm_ioc.description: Returns a flat array of SHA256 strings for artifacts observed in association with this IP. Paginated: has_more with an offset token means more pages exist. HTTP 204 with an empty body means not found.

Build_summary.description: result is a flat array of SHA256 strings, not objects. hasMore indicates the count shown is a page, not a total. Bodies are read only on HTTP 200; an HTTP 204 empty body is never parsed.

body.message:
PolySwarm IP enrichment
IP: @{replace(replace(replace(replace(string(items('For_each_ip')?['Address']), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"')}
Verdict (engine detection counts): @{concat(toUpper(substring(outputs('Build_summary')?['verdict'], 0, 1)), substring(outputs('Build_summary')?['verdict'], 1, sub(length(outputs('Build_summary')?['verdict']), 1)))} (@{if(equals(outputs('Build_summary')?['verdict'], 'unknown'), if(equals(outputs('Build_summary')?['hostStatus'], 204), 'PolySwarm has no record of this address (HTTP 204)', if(equals(outputs('Build_summary')?['hostStatus'], 200), 'no usable engine counts', concat('engine lookup unavailable, HTTP status ', string(coalesce(outputs('Build_summary')?['hostStatus'], 'no response'))))), concat(string(outputs('Build_summary')?['detectionsMalicious']), ' malicious of ', string(outputs('Build_summary')?['detectionsTotal']), ' engines'))})
@{if(equals(outputs('Build_summary')?['polyscore'], null), '', concat('PolyScore (reference only, not used for the verdict): ', formatNumber(outputs('Build_summary')?['polyscore'], '0.0000'), '
'))}@{if(equals(outputs('Build_summary')?['sha256'], null), '', concat('PolySwarm report: ', replace(replace(replace(replace(concat('https://polyswarm.network/scan/results/file/', string(outputs('Build_summary')?['sha256'])), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"'), '
'))}Association, a pivot lead: @{if(equals(outputs('Build_summary')?['associationStatus'], 200), if(equals(outputs('Build_summary')?['count'], 0), 'No analysed artifacts in the PolySwarm corpus are associated with this address.', concat('Associated artifacts: ', string(outputs('Build_summary')?['count']), if(equals(outputs('Build_summary')?['hasMore'], true), '+ (first page only, more available)', ''), '
', 'Sample: ', replace(replace(replace(replace(string(join(take(outputs('Build_summary')?['hashes'], parameters('SampleHashCount')), ', ')), '&', '&'), '<', '<'), '>', '>'), '"', '"'), '
')), if(or(equals(outputs('Build_summary')?['associationStatus'], 204), equals(outputs('Build_summary')?['associationStatus'], 404)), 'No analysed artifacts in the PolySwarm corpus are associated with this address.', concat('Association lookup unavailable (HTTP status ', string(coalesce(outputs('Build_summary')?['associationStatus'], 'no response')), ').')))}

Interpretation: association means these artifacts were observed contacting this address during analysis. It is a pivot lead, not a verdict; the verdict line comes from engine detection counts on the bare address. Shared infrastructure and public services accumulate large association counts without being malicious (a query for 8.8.8.8 fills a page), so weigh the count against how specific the address is before acting.

Select_host_artifact.description: result[0] of the bare-host lookup, read from the envelope's result list (the artifact has its own boolean result field, which is not read). Null unless the call returned HTTP 200 with at least one record; an HTTP 204 empty body is never parsed.

Compute_host_verdict.description: Engine-count verdict. total missing, unreadable or 0 is unknown; malicious missing or unreadable is unknown; malicious 0 is benign; malicious at or above total is malicious; otherwise suspicious. total is read, never derived. PolyScore plays no part.

Compute_total_count.description: detections.total as an integer, read from the record and never derived. Missing, null or unreadable becomes -1, so every expression is valid for null, string or integer input.

Compute_malicious_count.description: detections.malicious as an integer. Missing, null or unreadable becomes -1.

Add_enrichment_comment_to_incident_unles.description: Microsoft Sentinel can answer 409 when several playbooks comment on one incident at once, even though the comment was saved. A 409 is left alone; any other failure posts the comment once more.
